address: Jalan Goa Lempeh, Banjar Dinas Kangin, Uluwatu, Bali, Indonesia
tagline: Fifty-nine villas and mansions on a limestone cliff at Uluwatu.
description:
Bvlgari Resort Bali stands on the Bukit peninsula at Uluwatu, on a 160-metre limestone cliff above the Indian Ocean. It is the second property from Bvlgari Hotels & Resorts. The grounds cover 8.4 hectares, planted with frangipani. The beach and the beachside restaurant are for in-house guests. The street address is Jalan Goa Lempeh, Banjar Dinas Kangin, Uluwatu.

The resort has 59 villas and mansions. Categories named on the site include the Ocean View Villa, the Premier Ocean View Villa, the Ocean Cliff Villa, the Serpenti Villa, a three-bedroom mansion, a five-bedroom mansion and The Bvlgari Villa. Villas have private pools and butler service.

Sangkar Restaurant and the Bvlgari Bar are the dining rooms named on the resort pages, with the Bvlgari Spa for treatments. Breakfasts are included, and private yoga can be arranged around the clock. Complimentary village walks and a melukat are offered. The resort also arranges market visits with a personal shopper. Check-in is at 3 in the afternoon and check-out is at noon, as printed in the resort's general information.

Bali Ngurah Rai International Airport is the airport the resort names. A taxi is listed at IDR 400,000 per car each way. A hotel car is listed from IDR 2,300,000 to IDR 3,500,000 each way, including assistance for two. The resort does not print a driving time, so the transfer length is left unstated. Secured outdoor parking on site is complimentary. Car, taxi and helicopter are the arrivals the location notes list.

The parent organisation printed in the resort's site data is Marriott International. Reservations can be reached at bali.reservations@bulgarihotels.com, and the published telephones are +62 361 3001000 and +62 361 8471000.

Bvlgari Resort Bali suits travellers who want a cliffside villa stay at the southern tip of Bali, with a private pool, a beach reserved for the house, and dining on the property.
